# Katip

> Katip finds and masks personal data in Turkish legal documents (names, T.C. kimlik numbers, IBAN, phone, e-mail, address, plates, KVKK art. 6 health data) on the user's own computer. The browser app never uploads the document. It is open source (AGPL-3.0, commercial licence on request) and built for Turkish lawyers, law firms and in-house legal teams who want to share files with clients, experts or AI tools under KVKK (Law No. 6698).

Türkçe: Katip, Türkçe hukuk belgelerindeki kişisel verileri (ad soyad, T.C. kimlik no, IBAN, telefon, adres, sağlık bilgisi) avukatın kendi bilgisayarında bulup maskeleyen açık kaynak bir KVKK maskeleme ve anonimleştirme aracıdır.

What it does not do: it can miss values, masked text is usually still personal data (pseudonymised, not anonymous), and it does not replace a legal basis for transfers abroad (KVKK m.9). Users check the result.

## Use it

- [Katip Mask web app](https://fikrifirat.github.io/katip/): drop a PDF, scan, photo, Word file or UYAP .udf; masking runs in the browser tab
- [Hugging Face Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/f1k/katip-kvkk-anonymization): same app, with the larger Katip Mask Base model
- [Katip Kalkan for Claude](https://github.com/fikrifirat/katip/tree/main/connector): Claude plugin and Claude Desktop extension that masks client files on the computer before Claude reads them, then restores real names in the final document
- [katip-mask on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/katip-mask/): Python package for the same detection

## KVKK-Bench results (v0.1.2, 18 Nov 2026)

KVKK-Bench v0.1.2, scores out of 100, higher is better. *Overall* is the weighted F2 score for finding names in real text: Yargıtay decisions with Turkish and foreign names, and everyday Wikipedia sentences. *Forms* ◇ covers T.C. kimlik, tax numbers, IBANs and addresses on 306 synthetic petitions and bar forms; it is not in Overall, and blank means not run. Rows named Katip include Katip's rules. Live table and method: https://huggingface.co/spaces/f1k/kvkk-bench

| # | System | Overall | Turkish names (court) | Foreign names (court) | Everyday text | Forms ◇ | Size MB |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Katip Mask Base · tr v2](https://huggingface.co/f1k/katip-mask-base) | 96.1 | 99.9 | 97.7 | 84.8 | 98.3 | 111.1 |
| 2 | [XLM-RoBERTa Large NER](https://huggingface.co/FacebookAI/xlm-roberta-large-finetuned-conll03-english) | 95.9 | 97.6 | 97.5 | 89.9 | 41.6 | 2235.4 |
| 3 | [XLM-RoBERTa Base Turkish NER](https://huggingface.co/akdeniz27/xlm-roberta-base-turkish-ner) | 95.7 | 98.5 | 98.2 | 86.3 | – | 1109.8 |
| 4 | [Katip rules + GLiNER2 · tr fine-tuned](https://github.com/fikrifirat/katip/blob/legal-study/lab/colab/gliner2_katip_recipe.ipynb) | 95.5 | 98.7 | 97.3 | 86.0 | 98.2 | 1228.7 |
| 5 | [GLiNER2 PII Multi](https://huggingface.co/fastino/gliner2-privacy-filter-PII-multi) | 95.0 | 98.1 | 98.2 | 83.9 | 43.2 | 1228.4 |
| 6 | [Katip Mask Mini · tr v2](https://huggingface.co/f1k/katip-mask-mini) | 93.0 | 99.1 | 97.2 | 73.4 | 97.5 | 31.4 |
| 7 | [BERTurk NER](https://huggingface.co/savasy/bert-base-turkish-ner-cased) | 91.6 | 97.4 | 91.7 | 77.1 | 38.3 | 440.1 |
| 8 | [GLiNER Multi PII v1](https://huggingface.co/urchade/gliner_multi_pii-v1) | 91.3 | 93.1 | 92.9 | 85.2 | – | 1155.8 |
| 9 | [Katip Mask Nano · tr v1.1](https://huggingface.co/f1k/katip-mask-nano) | 85.9 | 94.4 | 95.5 | 55.2 | 96.6 | 2.9 |
| 10 | [ModernBERT-TR PII NER](https://huggingface.co/ytu-ce-cosmos/modernbert-tr-pii-ner) | 85.3 | 99.0 | 96.9 | 39.4 | – | 597.5 |
| 11 | [Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct (zero-shot)](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct) | 57.5 | 59.1 | 57.6 | 53.7 | – | 3087 |
| 12 | [Privacy Filter Multilingual v2](https://huggingface.co/OpenMed/privacy-filter-multilingual-v2) | 57.2 | 59.8 | 57.4 | 50.7 | – | 2799.2 |
| 13 | [Privacy Filter](https://huggingface.co/openai/privacy-filter) | 51.3 | 58.0 | 58.0 | 27.9 | – | 2799 |
| 14 | [Piiranha v1](https://huggingface.co/iiiorg/piiranha-v1-detect-personal-information) | 49.8 | 41.4 | 61.5 | 59.4 | – | 1112.9 |
| 15 | [Presidio](https://github.com/microsoft/presidio) | 45.0 | 39.3 | 44.0 | 60.4 | 36.1 | 11 |
| 16 | [OpenMed PII Turkish Small](https://huggingface.co/OpenMed/OpenMed-PII-Turkish-ClinicalE5-Small-33M-v1) | 19.1 | 11.8 | 18.8 | 37.5 | – | 133 |

## Models

- [Katip Mask Base](https://huggingface.co/f1k/katip-mask-base): BERTurk fine-tune, 111 MB int8 ONNX
- [Katip Mask Mini](https://huggingface.co/f1k/katip-mask-mini): 31 MB, distilled from Base, browser default
- [Katip Mask Nano](https://huggingface.co/f1k/katip-mask-nano): 2.5 MB, fast mode and the Katip Kalkan default; finds fewer names in everyday text than Mini or Base
